events.author: s_63h0z_rn9tGX5c93aI9sgKHb1iJO4JwP9NvPMuXsE
events.body:
## Summary

Rebuild the job/profile submission experience around Git-native artifacts instead of normal job-board forms.

The first provider remains GitLab. The flow should generate reviewable Markdown drafts and open GitLab issues or merge requests for maintainer review. GitHub/generic Git should be designed as future provider targets, not first-blocking implementation.

## Scope

- Post job from URL as draft generation, not crawler publishing.
- Manual job Markdown draft generation.
- Seeker profile Markdown draft generation.
- GitLab issue template handoff.
- Future MR/PR provider abstraction.
- Clear non-technical copy explaining what happens after submit.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Reword `public/add.html` and related homepage copy to emphasize reviewable Git submissions.
- [ ] Add or plan a Markdown preview/copy flow for job and seeker submissions.
- [ ] Keep GitLab issue templates as the first supported handoff.
- [ ] Document advanced path: submit an MR adding `jobs/*.md` or `seekers/*.md` directly.
- [ ] Remove product wording that implies random automatic fetching/publishing.
- [ ] Explain maintainer review and CI processing before publication.

## Parent

Tracked by #12: https://gitlab.com/owasp-blt/blt-jobs/-/work_items/2

---

Moved from https://gitlab.com/owasp-blt/blt-jobs/-/issues/5 (opened by @mdkaifansari04 on 2026-06-07).

**Discussion summary**

- The GitLab issue-template handoff was replaced: templates are in `blt-jobs/issue-templates/` and submissions are processed by `.forkmesh/blt-jobs--process-submissions.yml`.
events.title: blt-jobs: Rework job and profile submission into Git-native Markdown draft flows
